fields.description: Master switch for offloading File attachments to cloud object storage
fields.label: Enable Cloud Storage

fields.description: Enable scheduled and on-demand site backups to cloud storage
fields.label: Enable Cloud Backups

fields.description: S3-compatible object storage provider
fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
AWS S3
Wasabi
Backblaze B2
DigitalOcean Spaces
Cloudflare R2
Vultr Object Storage
Linode Object Storage
Scaleway
IDrive e2
MinIO / Other

fields.description: Cloudflare account ID. Endpoint becomes https://<account_id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
fields.label: R2 Account ID

fields.description: e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1. Automatically 'auto' for Cloudflare R2.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: Auto-filled from provider + region. Editable for MinIO / Other.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: Optional bucket-specific region override. Leave blank to use Region.
fields.label: Bucket Region

fields.description: Prefix for object keys. Defaults to the site name if blank.
fields.label: Folder Prefix

fields.description: Public domain for serving PUBLIC files directly (e.g. https://files.example.com or https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev). Leave blank to serve all files via presigned URLs.
fields.label: Public Base URL (CDN / R2 Public Domain)

fields.description: Upload files to cloud storage immediately when attached (via background job). When off, the hourly scheduler sweeps them up.
fields.label: Instant Upload

fields.description: Remove the local copy after a confirmed upload
fields.label: Delete Local File After Upload

fields.description: When a File is deleted in ERP, also delete the object from cloud storage
fields.label: Delete Cloud Object on ERP Deletion

fields.description: Presigned URL validity in seconds (default: 900 = 15 minutes)
fields.label: Presigned URL Expiry (seconds)

fields.description: Files processed per batch for scheduled uploads, bulk migration, and cleanup
fields.label: Batch Size

fields.description: Files attached to these DocTypes will NOT be uploaded to cloud storage
fields.label: Exempt DocTypes

fields.description: Include public and private file tarballs in the backup
fields.label: Backup Files

fields.description: Max time (seconds) for the backup background job. Increase for large sites. Default: 6000 (100 min).
fields.label: Backup Job Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Separate bucket for backups. Leave blank to use the main bucket.
fields.label: Backup Bucket Name

fields.description: Object key prefix for backup files
fields.label: Backup Folder Path

fields.description: Keep only the last N backups. Set 0 to disable.
fields.label: Keep Last N Backups

fields.description: Delete backups older than N days. Set 0 to disable.
fields.label: Delete Backups Older Than (days)

fields.description: Email address to receive backup notifications (failures always notify)
fields.label: Notify Email

fields.description: Send an email notification even when a backup succeeds
fields.label: Send Email for Successful Backup
